title: QuorumKit Agent Message (apm-msg)
description: Single machine-readable message emitted by an agent at the end of a step (FR-011, FR-012). v2 extension fields (event_type, pipeline_id, issue, pr, branch, timestamp) are optional for backward-compatibility — see docs/AGENT_PROTOCOL.md §2.0.

version.description: apm-msg schema version. v2 is the only supported value.

runId.description: Pipeline run UUID; must equal the active run.

step.description: Step name as declared in the pipeline.

agent.description: Agent slug (e.g. 'qa-agent', 'dev-agent') matching the agent identity registry.

iteration.description: 1-based iteration counter for the step on the current edge.

outcome.description: Declared outcome enum. Source of truth: docs/AGENT_PROTOCOL.md. 'start' is NOT a valid value — apm-msg blocks are emitted only at step completion or failure.

payload.description: Optional per-outcome payload. Schema is per-outcome; see regulation document.

event_type.description: v2 extension — discriminates agent-complete vs agent-fail lifecycle events. 'start' is NOT a valid value. Optional for backward-compatibility.

pipeline_id.description: v2 extension — NNN zero-padded issue number; null for cloud/CI runs. Optional for backward-compatibility.

issue.description: v2 extension — GitHub Issue number string (e.g. '42') or URL; null if not applicable. Optional for backward-compatibility.

pr.description: v2 extension — GitHub PR number string or URL; null when no PR is open. Optional for backward-compatibility.

branch.description: v2 extension — Git branch name at the time of emission. Optional for backward-compatibility.

timestamp.description: v2 extension — UTC timestamp of emission in ISO-8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Optional for backward-compatibility.
